structs.notes: Verdict resolved with size 62936 by bounds meeting (lower from ClientVisionSetData accesses at cvsData[59564] in CG_VisionSetsUpdate_PrePlayerStatePrediction, upper from pipViewParams written at 662648 by the pip x/y/width/height setters). The first pass (A117) said PipDef was unproven and that PIP_Set* used the server slot: both correct for the server side, but the client PipDef is written by CG_ServerCmdSP_ServerCommand (set_pip_* branches) through CG_Globals_SetLocal* accessors whose names carry the offset. The server PIP slot (g_PIP_SlotArray, 224 bytes per slot, one slot: PIP_AllocateForClient, G_PIP_Write/ReadSaveState 224, PIP_GetScriptField stride 224) is a different struct (PipSlot, not in IDA's struct list under that name); it is not PipDef. The s_PIP_* data labels at 0x14f71a1b4..0x14f71a260 lie inside that 224-byte slot (s_PIP_cachedSlotPtr is slot +4 = x, read by PIP_SetX); they are slot fields with wrong global names, not separate globals (not renamed here). CG_Globals_SetPlayerParamFloat0..3 write pipViewParams (ClientViewParams[1], 24 bytes at 662648), which is not part of PipDef. Nothing applied.
